title: prose-observation
description: Observation schema for a candidate prose record. Extends the resource-file observation with sentence sequence, addressing surface, declared mode, and the running valuation against which the body is evaluated.

path.description: Repository-relative path of the prose record.

frontmatter.description: Parsed YAML frontmatter of the record.

body.description: The prose body, post-frontmatter, as UTF-8 text.

sentences.description: The body split into an ordered list of sentences. Position in the list determines evaluation order: sentence i is evaluated against the running valuation after sentences 1..i-1.

addressing-surface.description: The union over sentences of the cells the body posits on.

mode.description: Declared Diátaxis mode, inferred from the file's path under prose/teaching/<mode>/ or from the structure named in frontmatter derives-from.

running-valuation.description: The valuation u against which the body is evaluated. Computed from repository state at lint time. Keyed by (predicate, subject, object); values in the four-bilattice.

accessibility-relation.description: The accessibility relation R between worlds for modal evaluation. Default is the federation accessibility relation when not specified.
